book.name: Mbouŋ To Yes Israela
book.title: Mbouŋ To Yes Israela Buk Song—Psalms

content: Maaron pale ighur atuya pa yes zeran sasaghati
Mbouŋ tane iŋarui saawe tau Doeg tau Edom tamazi na ila ipaes pa Saul ighe David ileep tomania Ahimelek

content.text: Yo ŋeer ariaŋam, mindai ta aliŋam izazaa, ve upakur ghom pa ŋgar saghati tau ugham pa Maaron tamtamon tooni?
Poia, ughamu lak! Eemon saawe isov, Maaron loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni ve iuluul zi. Ŋgar tooni tawe irau isov ne mako.
Yo ŋeer to karom! Monmon, uiliil eez to uvaghamunia tamtamon.
Ve saveeŋ isov tau ivotvot ila avom, ene imin gharghar tau maata kat.
Ŋgar poia ve saveeŋ onoon, yo lolom pani mako.
Ve ŋgar saghati ve saveeŋ karom, yo lolom pani kat.
Yo avom karom.
Ve saveeŋ sasaghati naol tau ivaghamunia tamtamon na, yo lolom pani kat.
Tauvene Maaron pale ivaghamun ghom le usaghat kat. Irau uburig muul mako.
I pale iloŋ ila ruum tsio loolo, ve isasaar ghom uvot ula muuri,
mako ipas ghom ila yes tau matazi yaryaare na sosozi, ve isik ghom uzila nugh to mateegha.
Ŋgar tau Maaron pale igham payo na, ighe zeran duduŋazi tighita, ene pale tiroi.
Mako tiŋiŋ payo, ve tisaav tighe:
“Aghita. Ene ŋeer tau loolo pa igham uleeŋ ila to Maaron ve iyooŋ ila tooni mako.
I kuaz tauu kat. Ve inumeer gabua tooni naol tawe toman ŋgar tooni saghati ighe pale ighamu ileep poi.”
Eemon yau pale nayooz tuŋia ve naleep malau izi taan, imin ai oliv tau iyooz iloŋ ila Rumei to Maaron sirsiira.
Pasaa, yau nanumeer Maaron naghe i pale loolo isaghav tamtamon tooni ve iuul zi taghon taghon gha ila.
Maaron, yau lolog poia kat pa ŋgar tau yo ughamu na.
Tauvene yau aat napait ghom pa poia tsio taghon taghon gha ila.
Ve napait ezam ila yes tau lolozi isaghav ghom ariaaŋ na matazi, ve nasavi ghom pazi naghe: Yo poiam le poiam kat.
